newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends flat, LME stock hike expected.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends flat, LME stock hike expected.

text.p: COMEX copper ended unchanged in relatively light trading with traders expecting a further hike in LME stocks on Tuesday, the day when many of the world's red metal executives gather in New York for the Copper Club dinner.
Traders were less certain about the extent of Tuesday's stock movement after being caught out by last week's sharp hike. Estimates for Tuesday's increase ranged from 3,500 to 8,000 tonnes.
Despite a modest easing of the backwardation in London, the pullback was not convincing enough to indicate any significant changed in the market, William O'Neill of Merrill Lynch said.
The backwardation fell to $173/$183 from over $200 Friday.
"It's something to watch - the next couple of days will be crucial. It's lasted longer than most people thought it would," O'Neill added.
March COMEX settled flat at 107.15 cents per pound, traded 107.90 to 106.15 cents. Spot February was off 0.20 cent at 108.50 cents.
